note: This is a custom shadcss manifest describing an HTML+CSS component library — it is NOT a shadcn CLI registry and intentionally does not conform to https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json. It is a machine-readable reference only (no CLI consumes it). Each component lists its CSS file, dependencies, example markup, and the classes it defines.
name: shadcss
description: shadcn's beauty, no JS framework. A modular HTML+CSS-only component library built on modern web standards.

tokens.description: All design tokens live as HSL CSS custom properties on :root. Override any token to retheme the entire framework.

components.a11y: Use a real <button> for each action with aria-label; decorative media icons get aria-hidden="true"; the optional trigger is an <a>/<button> stretched over the chip

components.a11y: Use role="group" with an aria-label; each .btn keeps its own focus and name

components.name: carousel

components.name: chart
components.description: Library-agnostic CSS shell for charts: a container frame (aspect-video, xs axis text), a tooltip card (indicator + label + value), and a legend row. Drop in any SVG/Canvas chart lib; the drawing needs JS.
components.notes: Visual layer only — the chart drawing needs a JS chart library. Colour convention mirrors shadcn: define --color-{key} on .chart-container (e.g. var(--chart-1)) and reference it; .chart-indicator reads --color-bg/--color-border. data-indicator="dot|line|dashed" on .chart-indicator; data-valign="top|bottom" on .chart-legend.
components.a11y: Give the SVG a <title>/<desc> or aria-label summarizing the data; provide a non-graph fallback table where the data matters

components.name: collapsible

components.name: combobox
components.description: A combobox: a trigger button (showing the selected value + chevron) that opens a popup list of options, each with a check indicator when selected. Includes a multi-select chips-input variant.

components.notes: Visual layer only. Filtering, keyboard nav, and open/close state need JS — use the Popover API (popovertarget + [popover]) or a small script. data-empty on the trigger mutes unselected text; data-highlighted drives the active item; aria-selected shows the check. Add role="option"/aria-selected to items yourself.
components.a11y: Trigger is a real <button> (aria-haspopup="listbox"); items use role="option" + aria-selected; roving tabindex/keyboard arrows need JS

components.name: direction
components.description: Bidirectional (LTR/RTL) support: a segmented LTR/RTL toggle switch, plus explicit [dir="rtl"] parity for the few holdouts. The whole framework already mirrors via logical properties, so setting dir on an ancestor rethemes everything.
components.notes: The flip is a one-liner: set document.documentElement.dir = 'ltr'|'rtl'. js: trigger (one native statement). All shadcss components use logical properties so they mirror automatically; this file adds the toggle UI and patches the native <select> chevron position under [dir="rtl"].
components.a11y: Use role="group" + aria-label on the toggle; each option is a real <button> with aria-pressed reflecting the active direction

components.name: drawer

components.a11y: Open via showModal(); native <dialog>; data-side edge

components.name: dropdown
components.description: Menu of actions. Uses Popover API via popovertarget attribute.

components.name: form
components.description: shadcn naming alias for form layout: a vertical grid of label + control + description + error message. The FormItem grid, error-tinted label, muted description, and destructive message styles.
components.markup:

components.notes: Layout + text styles only — validation state needs JS (or native :user-invalid). Set data-error="true" on .form-label to tint it destructive. Wire aria-describedby yourself in plain HTML: control ← description + message ids. For richer field layout see field.css.
components.a11y: Associate the control with description+message via aria-describedby; mark invalid controls aria-invalid="true"; keep .form-label a real <label for>

components.name: input-group
components.description: Bordered input shell hosting leading/trailing (or stacked) addons — icon, text, kbd, or button — around a borderless .input or .textarea. Wrapper owns the border + focus/error ring.

components.a11y: Pair the control with a <label>; addons are presentational (aria-hidden on decorative icons)

components.name: tabs
components.description: Pure CSS tabs using radios + :has(). No JS.
components.markup: …
components.notes: Selection lives on the native radios. role=tab/tablist/tabpanel are intentionally omitted: CSS cannot keep a static aria-selected in sync with :checked, so the honest, accessible model is a native radiogroup (true ARIA tabs/tabpanels with aria-controls/aria-labelledby require consumer JS to move selection).
components.a11y: radio + :has() — exposes as an accessible radiogroup with no JS. For full ARIA tabs (role=tab/tablist/tabpanel + arrow-key nav) add @russfranky/shadcss-js/tabs and data-sc-tabs

components.markup:

components.name: toggle
components.description: Two-state button with aria-pressed.
components.a11y: Standalone needs JS to flip aria-pressed; use toggle-group for zero-JS

components.name: toggle-group
components.description: Group of single/multi-select toggles via radios/checkboxes.
components.notes: Order is mandatory: each <input> MUST be the immediately-preceding sibling of its <label class="toggle-group-item">. The checked-highlight relies on the adjacent-sibling selector (input:checked + .toggle-group-item), so any element between the input and its label breaks the styling.
components.a11y: Native radios/checkboxes; no JS

components.name: tooltip
components.description: Hover/focus tooltip with 4 positions. Pure CSS via ::after.
components.a11y: Hover/focus via CSS — but ::after content is not in the AT tree; add aria-label/aria-describedby

components.name: typography
components.description: Prose styles for long-form text. Drop on blog posts / docs.
components.a11y: Prose styles + large/small/muted helpers

fields.js: none (zero JS) | trigger (one-line native showModal()/showPopover()) | consumer (real JS for full behavior)
